misconceptions.description: Writing a reflection that reports feelings ('it was helpful, I feel confident') with no recorded decision
misconceptions.trigger: reflection names no situation where a choice was made
misconceptions.feedback: A reflection on judgment logs decisions, not moods. Record each moment you accepted or overrode the AI and why.

misconceptions.description: Logging only the times you accepted AI advice, never a time you overrode it, so no judgment is visible
misconceptions.trigger: decision log has accepts but zero overrides
misconceptions.feedback: If you never overrode the AI, you were following, not judging. Show at least one override with its reason.

misconceptions.description: Recording accept or override but leaving the 'why' column empty
misconceptions.trigger: a decision row has no reason tied to a constraint or observation
misconceptions.feedback: Every accept or override needs a reason a reader can check, such as a standard you pasted or a fact you could not observe.
